@graph.name: Is VOS a Fresho alternative, and is it better than Fresho?

acceptedAnswer.text: Much smaller, deliberately, and you should hear that from us rather than later. Fresho is an operations system built for perishable wholesale, from the order through to the payment, and VOS covers ordering only. At moving a kitchen off the telephone, VOS wins that one. At delivery runs, invoicing, taking payment, picking, margin control or reporting, not at all, and none of it is planned. If that is what you need the software to be, theirs is a serious answer.

@graph.name: Would we have to rip out what we run now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not for either of us, and it is only fair to say so. Their order automation is described as working with the ERP you already have, and their own pricing notes say the parts can sit beside an existing system. VOS is additive too. The real difference is how much of the business each one expects to touch.

@graph.name: Their AI handles voicemails. Does VOS do that?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and it is worth being exact here because both products involve a voice. Theirs reads a voicemail your customer already left and works the order out of it. Ours has the customer speak into an app that builds the lines from their guide, which they then confirm. If your aim is to keep the voicemails coming and have them handled, that is their product and not ours.

@graph.name: We are not a fruit and veg or seafood house. Does that matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters for them in a good way: their guides and their named customers are in fresh protein and produce, and that depth is real. They also sell to general food service, so this is depth rather than a boundary. VOS cares less about the category, because a guide of tomatoes works the same way as a guide of dry goods.

@graph.name: Do our customers have to change what they do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Their published promise for OrderPilot is that customers carry on ordering exactly as they always have. They also sell an online ordering portal, where the habit does move. VOS only does the second of those, and only by voice, so what reaches you is already the buyer's own list. Worth stating the limit: that covers what comes through the app. A call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock.

They are the most open about this of anyone we compare against: a published starting figure, a setup fee, worked examples and a calculator, with prices by region. We publish nothing at all and give you a quote instead. Ask us and you will get a number for your own book rather than a table to interpret.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this takes 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have ordered by the end of day one. There are no modules to scope, which is why a Fresho alternative gets a look from people with one problem to solve rather than a program of work.

@graph.name: Where do the Fresho details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read off fresho.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: the modules they list, the order automation description, the category guides and the pricing page. Their saving figures and review scores belong to them and are not repeated here as results. If any of it has changed, the mistake is at our end.
